title: Trump Trade: Trump imposes additional tariffs on some Canadian goods
summary: The White House is imposing additional 50% tariffs on a number of Canadian goods in response to what the Trump administration calls trade discrimination against multiple U.S. products and industries. President Trump signed three proclamations targeting different sets of Canadian imports with big duties in response three separate areas, namely motor vehicles, alcohol, and dairy, where the U.S. claims it has been treated unfairly.
